messages:
Rhea (Design): noticed run-history is noisy when tool calls return big objects. can we render a tiny structured preview by default?
Luis (DevEx): yes. plan: show 2 top-level keys as 'key: value' rows, then a '+N' overflow pill. chevron expands full payload.
Anika (PM): important: keep the function name and schema version in the card header. helps debugging across rollouts.
Tess (A11y): accessibility: collapsed preview must be focusable and announce 'payload summary, 2 keys visible'. expansion must toggle aria-expanded and move focus into the expanded panel.
Rhea (Design): UX detail: make the chevron a small button with aria-label 'Expand payload'. add a separate card-level 'Show full output' action for power users.
Luis (DevEx): perf note: avoid re-stringifying big JSON each render. store a precomputed summary on the invocation object at write-time.
Anika (PM): add a copy-summary button on the compact preview. on errors show a red pill 'Tool error' with an 'open trace' link.
Tess (A11y): copy action should use aria-live polite and visible focus styles. also ensure overflow pill is keyboard reachable.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/compact-preview (build 5340) :rocket:
Luis (DevEx): I'll prototype behind a flag and demo in next sync. tagging @Tess for a11y review once PR is up.
Rhea (Design): copy strings: 'Expand payload' / 'Collapse payload' and card action 'Show full output'. keep microcopy concise.
